metadata.description: Agent automation plugins for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: automate
plugins.description: Expert advisor that helps you decide and create the right Claude Code automation (skills, hooks, subagents, permissions, etc.)

plugins.name: plan-cycle
plugins.description: File-based planning with annotation pipeline. Creates persistent markdown plans, companion ops guide, and supports impact/quality analysis via composable skills.

plugins.name: takeaway
plugins.description: Structured feedback extraction from skill/tool usage. Interviews the user, distills observations into portable principles, and produces two files — a project-specific evidence retrospective and a tool-agnostic lessons document an improving agent can consume.

plugins.name: refactor-discovery
plugins.description: Research methodology to surface non-obvious structural smell leads before promoting refactor candidates. Discovers project areas, investigates in parallel with subagents, synthesizes cross-cutting tensions, and produces a prioritized discovery document.

plugins.name: qa-architect
plugins.description: Beta contract-driven QA discovery, design, build, and audit workflow.

plugins.name: review-cycle
plugins.description: Beta change-verification workflow. Reconstructs what a diff does before reading any declared intent, routes review depth by a deterministic risk floor, applies intent-drift, architecture and risk lenses, and hands deterministic fixes to a hygiene lane that commits locally and never pushes.
